notes: - Feature: Bollinger Bands + Stochastic + Price Action strategy (client text), 5 s candles and 5 s expiry. CALL = candle low touches the lower band (BB 20, 2) + bullish rejection (lower wick >= half the range, close in the top 40%) + Stochastic (5,3,3) bullish crossover; PUT the mirror. All three required. No stake preset, no news pause. Included in the OTC backtester.
